name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS - NSAP)
description: IGNOAPS is a non-contributory old-age pension component under the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) providing social security and monthly financial sustenance to impoverished elderly citizens.
benefits: Provides a central monthly pension of ₹200 per month for beneficiaries aged 60 to 79 years, and ₹500 per month for beneficiaries aged 80 years and above. Many state governments augment this base amount with state contributions up to ₹1,000 to ₹3,000 per month.
eligibility: Applicants must be 60 years of age or older and must belong to a household living below the poverty line (BPL) according to criteria prescribed by the Government of India.
documents: Aadhaar card, BPL ration card or verified proof of BPL status, age verification certificate (birth certificate, voter card, or school leaving certificate), and bank or post office passbook.
application_process: Apply through the local Gram Panchayat in rural areas or Municipal Ward Office in urban areas. Submit application with BPL proof and age proof. Verification is conducted by local revenue/social welfare officers before district sanction.

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Elderly citizens aged 60+ from BPL households
